data: In Figure 3(b), does the value of ‖W‖/‖X‖ increase throughout the experiment?

The question asks whether the value of ‖W‖/‖X‖ increases throughout the experiment in Figure 3(b). From the caption, we know that Figure 3(b) corresponds to the "IDCNNhidden-layer" in CoNLL-2003. The blue line represents the ratio ‖W‖/‖X‖, and the red line represents ||Xmask||.

Looking at the blue line in Figure 3(b):
1. The blue line starts at approximately 0.9 and decreases to around 1.2 over the course of the experiment.
2. There is no clear indication that the blue line consistently increases throughout the experiment. Instead, it shows a general downward trend.

Therefore, based on the analysis of the blue line in Figure 3(b), the value of ‖W‖/‖X‖ does not increase throughout the experiment. It decreases slightly over time.
